title: Coral Nest
description: A delicate watercolor study of reef life, coral branches and warm tidal color drawn from a Maldivian lagoon at dusk.

title: Blue Tern
description: A layered gouache composition of a seabird and surrounding surf, exploring movement, light and coastal atmosphere.

title: Lime Reef
description: Digital illustration translating a coral reef into bold, graphic forms with luminous sea greens and amber reflections.

title: Sea Fan Script
description: A linear black-and-ink composition echoing coral filaments and tidal pattern in a clean archival style.

title: Mangrove Glow
description: A lush mangrove watercolor study with layered greens and silver reflections on still island water.

title: Manta Study
description: An elegant digital study of a manta ray in flight, built from atmospheric gradients and fluid linework.

title: Botanical Drift
description: An atmospheric botanical painting merging island leaves and coastal textures in a quiet, layered composition.

title: Harbor Quiet
description: A still harbor scene in muted greens and ivory, capturing the day’s soft light over a working island shore.

title: Atoll Memory
description: An oil painting built from slow brushwork and luminous water color that evokes island memory and fading light.

title: Sunlit Reef
description: A richly layered digital reef composition with warm, nearly translucent light moving across coral formations.

title: Faded Tide
description: Acrylic layers build a sedimented seascape with coastal hues and hand-drawn vegetal marks.

title: Sea Orchid
description: Bold floral forms and marine light combine in a compact acrylic work inspired by tropical blooms and reef shapes.

title: Palm Study
description: A quiet watercolor study of island palms and sunlight, balancing soft edges with a tactile studio palette.

title: Deep Current
description: A large oil painting of moving water and depth, interpreted through layered blues, green and brushed silver.

title: Mariner's Journal
description: A gouache vignette of a journal page and reef study, combining observation and narrative in an intimate format.
